segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: נוֹהֲגִין הָיוּ וְכוּ׳. תַּנְיָא אָמַר רַבִּי צָדוֹק: כָּךְ הָיָה מִנְהָגוֹ שֶׁל בֵּית רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, שֶׁהָיוּ נוֹתְנִין כְּלֵי לָבָן לְכוֹבֵס שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים קוֹדֶם לַשַּׁבָּת, וּצְבוּעִים אֲפִילּוּ בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת. וּמִדִּבְרֵיהֶם לָמַדְנוּ שֶׁהַלְּבָנִים קָשִׁים לְכַבְּסָן יוֹתֵר מִן הַצְּבוּעִין.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said:» The ancestral house of my father, the dynasty of Nesi’im from the house of Hillel, «was accustomed» to give its white clothes to a gentile launderer no fewer than three days before Shabbat. «It was taught» in the Tosefta that «Rabbi Tzadok said: This was the custom of the house of Rabban Gamliel: They would give white clothes to the» gentile «launderer three days before Shabbat, and» they would give him «colored» clothes «even on Shabbat eve.» The Gemara comments: «And from their statement we learned that white» garments «are more difficult to launder than colored ones,» as in white garments every stain is more conspicuous.
